docs.title: 📋 Pre-Flashing Requirements
docs.text:
Before flashing any custom ROM, make sure you check off every item below:

Mandatory Checklist

  • Unlocked Bootloader: Your Xiaomi/POCO device bootloader must be completely unlocked.
  • Complete Backup: All user data, photos, and messages will be wiped during the required format data step. Backup to a PC or cloud.
  • Platform Tools: Install the official Google ADB & Fastboot Tools.
  • Stock Firmware: Ensure your device is updated to the latest official HyperOS / MIUI firmware required by the ROM.
  • Custom Kernels: Custom kernels are not supported. Please do not report bugs if third-party kernels or modules are flashed.

docs.title: Google Apps (GApps)
docs.text: Most custom ROM builds are released either as Vanilla (clean AOSP without Google apps/services) or GApps (with Google Play Store and core services pre-included).

docs.title: 📦 Recommended GApps Package
docs.text:
If you are flashing a Vanilla build and want Google Play services, we officially recommend MindTheGapps.

MindTheGapps

This is the reference Google Apps package maintained by LineageOS contributors. It is lightweight, stable, and includes only essential core services without unnecessary bloat.

  • Official Downloads: MindTheGapps Website
  • Architecture: Always download the arm64 package for all devices on this wiki.
  • Android Version Match: Ensure you download the package matching the exact Android version of the ROM (e.g. Android 13, 14, or 16).

docs.title: ⚡ Flashing Instructions
docs.text:
Follow this exact sequence when installing GApps on a Vanilla ROM build:

  1. Flash your ROM first via recovery: 
    adb sideload <rom_filename>.zip
  2. In recovery, navigate to Advanced ➔ Reboot to recovery.
  3. Once back in recovery, select Apply update ➔ Apply from ADB.
  4. Sideload the matching GApps package: 
    adb sideload <gapps_package>.zip
  5. Select Reboot system now.

Do NOT Flash on GApps Builds

If the ROM download specifically mentions that it is a GApps or Official with GApps build, do NOT flash any separate GApps package. Doing so will cause permission conflicts and endless bootloops!

docs.title: Troubleshooting & FAQ
docs.text: If you run into any issues during installation or daily usage, consult the solutions below.

docs.title: ⚠️ Common Flashing Errors
docs.text:
Device Bootloops or boots straight back into Recovery

Why it happens: - You did not format data during a clean flash (encrypting / mismatching existing data). - You flashed a separate GApps zip onto a build that already has GApps included. - You flashed an incompatible custom kernel or Magisk module.

Solution: 1. Force power off by holding ++power++ + ++volume-up++ until entering recovery mode. 2. Go to Factory Reset ➔ Format data / factory reset and confirm. 3. Reboot to system.

Error 1 / Verification Failed during adb sideload

Why it happens: - The downloaded ROM file was corrupted during download. - An outdated or incompatible recovery is being used.

Solution: 1. Verify the SHA256 checksum or re-download the ROM zip file. 2. Flash the recommended recovery image explicitly specified in the device's install guide.

Device is not detected by fastboot or adb

Why it happens: - Missing or corrupt Google USB / Xiaomi Fastboot drivers on Windows. - Faulty USB cable or USB 3.0/3.1 port handshake issue.

Solution: 1. Download and install the Google USB Driver. 2. Use a USB 2.0 port or a USB 2.0 hub (USB 3.x ports on AMD motherboards often drop fastboot connections). 3. Verify detection in terminal: 

fastboot devices

docs.title: 📋 How to Capture a Logcat for Bug Reports
docs.text:
When reporting crashes or issues in the Telegram group, providing a log is essential for debugging:

From a Booted DeviceFrom Recovery (If Device Won't Boot)
  1. Enable Developer Options (tap Build Number 7 times in Settings ➔ About Phone).
  2. Enable USB Debugging.
  3. Connect your phone to your computer and run: 
    adb logcat -d > logcat.txt
  4. Send the generated logcat.txt in the group with a clear description of the bug.
  1. Boot into Recovery and connect your phone to your PC.
  2. Run: 
    adb pull /tmp/recovery.log
  3. Send recovery.log when asking for help.

docs.title: Installation Instructions — Redmi Note 11 (spes)
docs.text: Follow these instructions carefully to flash Custom ROMs onto your device.

docs.title: ⚠️ Important Prerequisites
docs.text:
Data Loss Warning

Flashing a custom ROM requires formatting your internal storage. Backup all important documents, photos, and two-factor authenticator apps before proceeding!

  • Bootloader: Unlocked via Xiaomi Community / Mi Flash Unlock Tool.
  • Firmware: Ensure your device is on the latest official stock HyperOS/MIUI firmware for your regional variant.
  • Recommended Recovery: Official AOSP Recovery / Recommended Recovery provided with the build.
  • Computer Setup: Install official Android Platform Tools (ADB & Fastboot).

Recovery Navigation

Inside AOSP Recovery, use the ++volume-up++ / ++volume-down++ buttons to navigate options and the ++power++ button to confirm your selection.

docs.title: 🚀 Flashing Process
docs.text:
Clean Flash (New Installation)Dirty Flash (Updating Existing ROM)

Use this method if you are coming from stock firmware or switching between different custom ROMs.

Use this method only when updating to a newer build of the same ROM.

  1. Boot into recovery mode (press and hold ++volume-up++ + ++power++ while powering on).
  2. In recovery, select Apply update ➔ Apply from ADB.
  3. On your computer, sideload the update zip: 
    adb sideload <updated_rom_filename>.zip
  4. (Optional) If your ROM build requires manual GApps re-flashing:
  5. Go to Advanced ➔ Reboot to recovery.
  6. Select Apply from ADB and run adb sideload <gapps_filename>.zip.
  7. In the main menu, select Reboot system now. (Do NOT format data).

docs.title: Step 1: Boot into Fastboot
docs.text:
Power off your device completely, then press and hold ++volume-down++ + ++power++ until the FASTBOOT screen appears.

Alternatively, if booted into Android with USB Debugging enabled: 

adb reboot bootloader

docs.title: Step 2: Flash Recovery
docs.text:
Open a terminal on your computer in the folder containing your recovery image: 

fastboot flash boot recovery.img

docs.title: Step 3: Reboot to Recovery
docs.text:
Reboot directly into recovery mode: 

fastboot reboot recovery

docs.title: Step 4: Format Data
docs.text: In recovery menu: 1. Select Factory Reset 2. Select Format data / factory reset and confirm.

docs.title: Step 5: Sideload the ROM
docs.text:
1. In recovery, select Apply update ➔ Apply from ADB.
  2. Connect your phone to your computer via USB.
  3. In your terminal, run: 
    adb sideload <rom_filename>.zip
  4. (Optional) If flashing a Vanilla build and you require Google services, reboot back to recovery (Advanced ➔ Reboot to recovery), then sideload your GApps package: 
    adb sideload <gapps_filename>.zip

docs.title: Step 6: Reboot to System
docs.text: Return to the main recovery menu and select Reboot system now. First boot may take 2-3 minutes.

docs.title: 🛠️ Need Help?
docs.text: If you run into issues or fastboot errors during installation, refer to our Troubleshooting Guide or ask in our Telegram Community.
